record.paper_title: On some open problems of number theory
record.original_question: A finite system of congruences x congruent to a_i modulo m_i is covering if every integer x satisfies at least one congruence in the system. Does there exist a covering system whose moduli m_i are all distinct odd integers greater than 1?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A covering system is a finite collection of congruences
    x ≡ a_i (mod m_i),  i = 1, 2, …, k,
with integers a_i and positive integer moduli m_i > 1, such that every integer x satisfies at least one of these congruences.

Question: Does there exist a covering system in which the moduli m_1, m_2, …, m_k are pairwise distinct odd integers, each greater than 1?
artifact.status_search_result: The odd covering problem (Erdős–Selfridge) asking whether a covering system exists with all moduli distinct odd integers greater than 1 remains open. Partial results restrict the structure of any hypothetical such system (e.g., the lcm of the moduli must be divisible by 9 or 15; in the square-free case it must have at least 22 prime divisors), and ongoing work (e.g., 2021 and 2025 preprints) continues to investigate the problem, but no full resolution is known.

status_evidence.title: Odd incongruent covering systems | Open Problem Garden
status_evidence.snippet: A famous unsolved conjecture of P. Erdős and J. L. Selfridge states that there does not exist a covering system with moduli odd, distinct and greater than one.
status_evidence.claim: The odd covering problem is listed as an unsolved conjecture.

status_evidence.title: A further investigation on covering systems with odd moduli
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2025) investigation continues on covering systems with odd moduli, indicating the problem is still under active study.
status_evidence.claim: Active research in 2025 indicates the problem remains open.

status_evidence.title: Covering systems with odd moduli
status_evidence.snippet: Studies structural constraints on hypothetical odd covering systems.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress restricts the structure of any potential odd covering system.
